description: Registers the developer's server to receive Toolaby's events on Test, and writes its signing secret into an env file as TOOLABY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, never shown. A server that mirrors buyers gets no event until its endpoint is registered: on Test, this is yours to do as part of the job, not a step to leave to the person; toolaby_remove_webhook undoes it. The url is the server's public address and the handler's path (a tunnel's while developing, like https://…trycloudflare.com/webhooks/toolaby).

envFile.description: The env file the server reads, like ".env", for TOOLABY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

events.description: Optional: only these events (toolaby_list_webhook_events); all of them when left out.

url.description: The public https address of the handler.

workspace.description: The workspace slug, when you have more than one (toolaby_whoami lists them).

name: toolaby_add_webhook
title: Register a webhook endpoint
